scope: source inspection of freshly reproduced peer candidate
observations: AndesGetCmdMsgSeq cycles 1..15 and excludes only currently queued ACK sequences
checked receive matches sequence then EXT_EVENT/EXT_EVENT_CMD_RESULT, exact packet and declared lengths, radio command result and firmware status
No attempt generation echoed in firmware response is checked
inference: A late same-command response after timeout and sequence reuse may satisfy a later checked command. Source inspection does not prove arrival timing or actual occurrence.
required_next_step: Establish a protocol-supported drain/reset epoch or nonreuse rule covering all command issuers before accepting checked radio-off completion; retain LOAD_FW_ONE_TIME refusal meanwhile.

reset_drain_review.AndesCtrlPciInit: resets cmd_seq to zero and initializes queues
reset_drain_review.AndesCtrlPciExit: clears send/MCU flags, kills tasklet and frees software queues/locks; this function contains no hardware reset or DMA/IRQ completion proof
reset_drain_review.conclusion: Software MCU reinitialization alone cannot establish an epoch excluding delayed firmware responses. Audit complete hardware producer stop/reset before claiming epoch safety.

close_callsite_review.irq_wrapper: os/linux/rt_linux.c RtmpOSIRQRelease invokes free_irq for PCI
close_callsite_review.limit: Ordering supplies a candidate IRQ synchronization boundary before MCU cleanup but does not prove firmware no-late-response epoch after restart. Tasklet rearm and ring ownership must be checked with effective paths.

tasklet_review.entry: RtmpNetTaskExit calls wr_iot_nettask_block_drain before any tasklet kill
tasklet_review.submission_guard: wr_iot_nettask_schedule admits under dedicated lock, counts inflight submissions, then wakes drain waiters on leave
tasklet_review.drain: blocks admission under same lock, refuses initializing/atomic contexts and waits up to 5000ms before join
tasklet_review.limit: Only guarded network-cookie tasklets are covered; complete IRQ/MCU and DMA producers still require separate evidence.

extracted_allocator_check: Actual AndesGetCmdMsgSeq body compiled with GCC C11 Wall Wextra Werror, empty-ackq lock/list stubs: sequence1 repeats on allocation16. Passed; this proves allocator reuse only, not late firmware response occurrence.

on_off_disambiguation.response: _EVENT_EXT_CMD_RESULT_T carries only ucExTenCID, three reserved bytes and u4Status; no ON/OFF echo
on_off_disambiguation.parser: radio-result.h already explicitly limits itself to payload syntax/status
on_off_disambiguation.consequence: A stale successful RADIO_ON result with reused sequence also cannot be distinguished from RADIO_OFF by current result fields. Ownership wrapper alone cannot prove OFF completion.
on_off_disambiguation.next_requirement: Establish nonreuse/drain epoch covering both ON and OFF plus all legacy issuers; do not infer new OFF receipt from parser result alone.
